description: This file contains the implementation of the Attribute controller class for the OpenCart admin catalog module. It includes methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, and saving product attribute data within the admin interface.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class for managing product attributes in the OpenCart admin catalog module, facilitating listing, form display, and saving of attribute data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main attribute listing page, setting up breadcrumbs, filters, and retrieving attribute data for display.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response containing a list of attributes, usually for AJAX calls in the admin interface.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of attributes, including sorting, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a product attribute, pre-filling data if editing an existing item.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the attribute create/edit form, validating permissions and data, then saving to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attributes, ensuring permission checks and providing JSON feedback.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of attribute suggestions based on filters for use in autocomplete fields.
